properties.name: Cascade Apartment 6
properties.description: Cascade Apartment 6 is a fully self-contained three-bedroom, two-bathroom apartment sleeping up to 10 guests, set over two levels in the heart of Mt Baw Baw Village. Recently renovated, the apartment features a fully equipped kitchen with large dining table, a comfortable lounge with flat screen TV, gas heater and a balcony with spectacular mountain views. Hydronic heating is installed throughout the lower level. Only 2 hours from Melbourne, Mt Baw Baw offers world-class skiing in winter and mountain biking, fishing, and bushwalking in summer — making Cascade Apartment 6 the perfect year-round alpine getaway.

bedrooms.name: Bedroom 1
bedrooms.description: Queen size bed with ensuite bathroom nearby

bedrooms.name: Bedroom 2
bedrooms.description: Large room with tri-bunk (double on bottom, single on top) and a single bunk bed, sleeping up to 5. Opens onto a bathroom.

policies.notes: Weekend bookings (Friday and Saturday nights) require a minimum 2-night stay. Pillows and doonas/blankets supplied. Linen and towels must be brought or hired from Guest Services (pre-booking advised).
